column1: # Authored from the 2024 PHB SRD (CC-BY 4.0). Spot-check against the printed PHB — wording may have been adjusted in errata.

column2: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

You are part of an elven lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table: Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell as listed in the table. You always have the listed spell prepared. Once you cast a spell with this trait without expending a spell slot, you can't cast that spell with this trait again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the one you chose for the Elven Lineage.
You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
column4: Adds advantage on saves vs the Charmed condition

column2: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.
You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
column4: Auto adds Common, Elvish to languages
